conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Modern embalming relies on chemicals like formaldehyde to preserve the body, focusing on sanitation and long-term preservation. Both methods aim to slow decomposition, but with different approaches and levels of effectiveness.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. What are some of the ethical considerations surrounding modern embalming practices?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
